grammar.title: 先……再…… (first ... then ...)
grammar.pattern: Subject + 先 + Verb1 + 再 + Verb2
grammar.explanation: 用「先……再……」說出動作的前後次序：先做第一件事，做完以後再做第二件事。兩個動作都是同一個人做的，主語放在「先」的前面。

examples.hanzi: 我每天先起床，再吃早餐。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān xiān qǐchuáng, zài chī zǎocān.
examples.gloss: Every day I get up first, then eat breakfast.

examples.pinyin: wǒmen xiān chīfàn, zài qù chànggē.
examples.gloss: Let's eat first, then go sing.

examples.hanzi: 你先答完這題，再看電視。
examples.pinyin: nǐ xiān dá wán zhè tí, zài kàn diànshì.
examples.gloss: Finish this question first, then watch TV.

grammar.title: 因為……,所以……(because…, so…)
grammar.pattern: 因為 + 原因 ,所以 + 結果
grammar.explanation: 用「因為」說明原因,用「所以」說明結果,兩個一起用很常見。也可以只用其中一個。

examples.hanzi: 因為我生病了,所以不能去游泳。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ bù néng qù yóuyǒng.
examples.gloss: Because I'm sick, I can't go swimming.

examples.hanzi: 因為天氣很陰,所以我們沒去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn yīn, suǒyǐ wǒmen méi qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.gloss: Because it was overcast, we didn't go cycling.

examples.hanzi: 因為她很想學跳舞,所以每週六都去上課。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tā hěn xiǎng xué tiàowǔ, suǒyǐ měi zhōu liù dōu qù shàngkè.
examples.gloss: Because she really wants to learn to dance, she goes to class every Saturday.

grammar.title: A 在 B 的左邊 (A is to the left of B)
grammar.pattern: A + 在 + B + 的左邊
grammar.explanation: 說明東西或地點的位置時,用「在……的左邊」。

examples.gloss: The hospital is to the left of the post office.

examples.hanzi: 我家在那家咖啡店的左邊。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài nà jiā kāfēi diàn de zuǒbiān.
examples.gloss: My home is to the left of that coffee shop.

examples.hanzi: 捷運站在銀行的左邊,很近。
examples.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhàn zài yínháng de zuǒbiān, hěn jìn.
examples.gloss: The MRT station is to the left of the bank, very close.

grammar.title: Quantity with 公斤 (Number + 公斤 + Noun)
grammar.pattern: Subject + 買/要/有 + Number + 公斤 + (Noun)
grammar.explanation: 公斤 (kilogram) is a measure word for weight. Put it directly after a number, and the noun comes after it: 兩公斤西瓜 'two kilos of watermelon'. When the noun is already known, you can leave it out: 我要三公斤。 In Taiwan you will hear this a lot at markets and shops.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng gōng jīn xī guā.
examples.gloss: I bought two kilos of watermelon.

examples.pinyin: Lǎo bǎn, wǒ yào yì gōng jīn yú.
examples.gloss: Boss, I'd like one kilo of fish.

examples.hanzi: 這些菜有三公斤,不太貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē cài yǒu sān gōng jīn, bú tài guì.
examples.gloss: These vegetables weigh three kilos and aren't too expensive.
